name: tacroman-vscode
description: TAcroMan acronym completions, diagnostics, and Quick Fixes for LaTeX in Visual Studio Code.

tacroman.databasePath.description: Optional path to the TAcroMan JSON database. Relative paths are resolved from the workspace folder. Leave empty for automatic discovery of acronyms.json files.

tacroman.latexCommands.description: LaTeX commands for which TAcroMan should offer completion inside the first braced argument. Enter command names without the leading backslash.

tacroman.executablePath.description: Executable used by 'TAcroMan: Open TAcroMan'. This can be tacroman from PATH or an absolute path to a TAcroMan executable.

tacroman.launchArguments.description: Additional arguments passed when TAcroMan is launched from VS Code.

tacroman.maxCompletionItems.description: Maximum number of acronym completion items returned at once.

tacroman.plainTextCompletion.description: Offer acronym completions while typing known short or long forms directly in LaTeX prose.

tacroman.plainTextDiagnostics.description: Detect known acronyms written as plain text in LaTeX documents and offer Quick Fixes.

tacroman.quickFixSingularCommand.description: LaTeX command used by the Quick Fix for singular plain-text acronyms (without the leading backslash).

tacroman.quickFixPluralCommand.description: LaTeX command used by the Quick Fix for plural plain-text acronyms (without the leading backslash).

tacroman.inferPlainTextPlurals.description: Also recognize a simple short-form plural by appending s when the TAcroMan database has no explicit short_plural value.

tacroman.ignoredArgumentCommands.description: LaTeX commands whose first braced argument should be ignored by plain-text acronym detection. Enter names without the leading backslash.
